name: B10-0039/2024 (ECR) – Continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text:
This is a statement of the European Parliament's position, not a law. It asks European Union countries to keep giving Ukraine money and weapons, to lift limits on how Ukraine uses those weapons, to send more air defence and long-range missiles, to spend more on defence, and to keep and tighten sanctions on Russia. It also calls for Russia to pay for the damage it caused and for its leaders to face justice.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of demands to European Union governments.
- **Who it affects:** European Union member states, Ukraine, Russia and the North Atlantic Treaty Organization allies.
- **What happens next:** It is sent to the Council, the Commission, member states, Ukraine, the United Nations, the United States and NATO for them to act on.
